mapper.select: SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, a.order_id, a.profitsharing_status, a.total_fee, IF(IFNULL((a.total_fee * (a.profitsharing_rate / 10000)), 0) >= 1, a.total_fee * (a.profitsharing_rate / 10000), 0) AS charge, IFNULL(CONVERT(a.profitsharing_rate / 100, DECIMAL(15, 2)), 0) AS profitsharing_rate, b.name AS distributor_name, a.distributor_id, a.order_status, a.delivery_status, a.receipt_type, a.ziti_status, a.cancel_status, a.is_invoiced, a.app_pay_type FROM orders_normal_orders a LEFT JOIN distribution_distributor b ON a.distributor_id = b.distributor_id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.order_id = #{orderId} AND a.order_status NOT IN ('NOTPAY', 'PART_PAYMENT', 'WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS') AND a.pay_status <> 'NOTPAY'
